title: 22. How do I copy an existing survey?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I copy an existing survey.
short_answer: On the 'Surveys' page, open the survey you want and click on the 'Copy' icon. In the dialogue box that opens you can modify the necessary settings, and then click on 'Create'. Your survey will be added to the list on the 'Surveys' page. You can start editing right away.
